answer.reason: The verses tell several defining events of the city: David's capture of it, the building of the temple, and its burning by Babylon.

clauses.english: was taken by David from the Jebusites and became the city of David
clauses.quote: David took the strong hold of Zion: the same is the city of David

clauses.english: was where Solomon began to build the house of the LORD
clauses.quote: Solomon began to build the house of the LORD at Jerusalem

clauses.english: had its houses burned and its walls broken down by the Chaldeans
clauses.quote: brake down the walls of Jerusalem round about

doubts: The Salem of Melchizedek (GEN 14:18, HEB 7:1-2) is marked but not named as Jerusalem in the verses given, so it was left out.
Many marked verses only mention Jerusalem as a setting, a residence or the subject of prophecy, and were not used.
